dedupe_keys.name: supplementary data to three scenarios for coal power in vietnam

description: The Viet Nam energy-transition group deposits a spreadsheet supporting a study of three coal-power futures. The public CC BY 4.0 ODS lists generating-unit capacities, creation dates and status through March 2019, then defines Blazing up, Closed window and Coal peak scenarios. The provider says these correspond to a revised power-development plan, an illustrative market-led path and a stronger policy transition path. A modeller could compare capacity-retirement or generation-expansion assumptions in a Vietnamese electricity-system simulation. The scenarios are interpretations from a study, not observed future outcomes or an official forecast for every later year. The landing page does not state all unit identifiers, closure dates, emissions factors or technology costs. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this coal-unit and scenario workbook. The ODS was not downloaded, so formulas, values and correspondence with the manuscript tables remain unverified.
name: Supplementary data to "Three scenarios for coal power in Vietnam"
